# Setup
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Load packages
library(qualtRics) # to read in qualtrics survey data

library(readr)
library(tidyverse)

# For RegCheck & text cleaning
library(jsonlite)
library(purrr)
library(textclean)
library(stringr)
library(hunspell)

# Read in data
human_raw <- read_survey("../Data/Raw/RegCheck_Validation_Coding.csv")
recoding <- read_survey("../Data/Raw/RegCheckrecoding.csv")
exclusions <- read_csv("../Data/Raw/exclusions.csv") #articles that may have been coded but should be excluded

# Need to load in round 2 of coding once we have it.

```

# Data cleaning - human data
```{r}
# exclusions
  # article_num 63, earlier article from SiB & AM (wrong experiment originally assigned)
human_processed <- human_raw  |> 
  filter(!(article_num == 63 & grepl("2", study_num)))
  
  # article_num 99, just SiB (wrong experiment originally assigned)
human_processed <- human_processed |> 
  filter(!(article_num == 99 & grepl("3", study_num)))

  # other articles that were coded and subsequently excluded
exclusions <- exclusions |> 
  filter(exclude == "Excluded")

human_processed <- human_processed |> 
  filter(!article_num %in% exclusions$article_num)

## ------------

#combine recoding - where authors had updated preregistrations, several coders coded the latest version although the codebook instructed to code the original. 
  # There were only 6 preregistrations with an update. 2 of these contained very minor updates. In all, only some dimensions for 4 papers needed to be recoded.
recode_long <- recoding |>
  select(ResponseId, coder_initial, matches("^\\d+_")) |>
  rename(`90_samplesize_dev_t` = `90_samplesize_dev_te`) |>
 pivot_longer(
    matches("^\\d+_"),
    names_pattern = "^(\\d+)_(.*)$",
    names_to = c("article_num", "item"),
    values_to = "value"
  ) |>
  mutate(article_num = as.integer(article_num)) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = item, values_from = value)

recode_long <- recode_long |>
  filter(!if_all(-c(ResponseId, coder_initial, article_num), is.na)) # remove rows for articles each coder didn't code 

item_cols <- setdiff(names(recode_long), c("ResponseId", "coder_initial", "article_num"))

# clean up column names in recode to swap in to main dataset

matches <- lapply(item_cols, \(x) grep(paste0("^", x), names(human_processed), value = TRUE))
names(matches) <- item_cols


stopifnot(lengths(matches) == 1)

recode_replace <- recode_long |>
  select(-ResponseId) |>
  pivot_longer(-c(coder_initial, article_num), names_to = "item", values_to = "value") |>
  mutate(dimension = str_replace(str_remove(item, "_.*$"), "^measurvars$", "measurevars")) |>
  group_by(coder_initial, article_num, dimension) |>
  filter(any(!is.na(value))) |>    # keep whole block if ANY cell is filled
  ungroup()

recode_replace <- recode_replace |>
  mutate(col = vapply(item, \(x) grep(paste0("^", x), names(human_processed), value = TRUE), character(1)))

idx <- match(
  paste(recode_replace$coder_initial, recode_replace$article_num),
  paste(human_processed$coder,  human_processed$article_num)
)
stopifnot(!anyNA(idx))

for (i in seq_len(nrow(recode_replace))) {
  human_processed[[recode_replace$col[i]]][idx[i]] <- recode_replace$value[i]
}


## ------------

# sanity check -- 100 unique articles, 2 coders each
length(unique(human_processed$article_num))

human_processed |> 
  group_by(article_num) |> 
  summarise(times_coded = n(),
            n_coders = n_distinct(coder),
            coders = paste(sort(coder), collapse = ", "),
            .groups = "drop") |>   
  filter(times_coded != 2 | n_coders != 2)

# For consistency, clean up two variable names
human_processed <- human_processed |> 
  rename(measurvars_dev_text = measurevars_dev_text,
         measurvars_notreg = measurevars_notreg)

write.csv(human_processed, file = "../Data/Processed/human_processed.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

## Pivot the data wider
```{r}
data_long <- human_processed %>%
  select(
    article_num, coder, study_num,
    matches("^(hypothesis|datas|inex|samplesize|manvars|measurvars|stats|transf|missd)_(prereg|paper|notreg|deviation|concerns|conf|comments)$")
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(article_num, coder, study_num),
    names_to  = c("dimension", ".value"),
    names_pattern = "^(.+?)_(prereg|paper|notreg|deviation|concerns|conf|comments)$"
  )
```

## Convert to pairwise comparisons
```{r}
# Get all unique coder pairs
coders <- unique(data_long$coder)
coder_pairs <- combn(sort(coders), 2, simplify = FALSE)  # sort alphabetically (so that we don't get both BC_JC and JC_BC later)

# Build one pairwise row per article_num x dimension x pair
data_pairs <- map_dfr(coder_pairs, function(pair) {
  c1 <- pair[1]; c2 <- pair[2]
  
  left  <- data_long %>% filter(coder == c1) %>%
    select(article_num, study_num, dimension, 
           prereg_c1 = prereg, paper_c1 = paper,
           deviation_c1 = deviation, concerns_c1 = concerns)
  
  right <- data_long %>% filter(coder == c2) %>%
    select(article_num, dimension,
           prereg_c2 = prereg, paper_c2 = paper,
           deviation_c2 = deviation, concerns_c2 = concerns)
  
  left %>%
    inner_join(right, by = c("article_num", "dimension")) %>%
    mutate(
      coder1 = c1,
      coder2 = c2,
      coder_pair       = paste(c1, c2, sep = "_"),
      deviation_agree  = as.integer(deviation_c1 == deviation_c2)
    )
})

data_pairs_cosine <- data_pairs %>%
  select(article_num, study_num, dimension, coder1, coder2, coder_pair, deviation_agree,
         prereg_c1, prereg_c2, paper_c1, paper_c2) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(prereg_c1, prereg_c2, paper_c1, paper_c2),
    names_to = c("source", "coder_num"),
    names_pattern = "^(prereg|paper)_(c1|c2)$"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = coder_num, values_from = value) %>%
  rename(text_c1 = c1, text_c2 = c2)

data_pairs_agree <- data_pairs # We will use the non long form for the agree variable
```

## Add in data from disagreement meetings and save the cleaned human data
```{r}
# Human data: resolved disagreements
regcheck_disagreements_resolved <- read_csv("../Data/Raw/regcheck_disagreements_resolved.csv")

regcheck_disagreements_resolved_cleaned <- regcheck_disagreements_resolved |> 
  select(c(article_num, dimension, final_deviation_decision, PRE_meeting_comments, POST_meeting_comments))

human_paired_resolved <- left_join(data_pairs_agree, regcheck_disagreements_resolved_cleaned,
                               by = c("article_num", "dimension")) |>
  mutate(
    deviation_c1 = if_else(grepl("too vague to tell", deviation_c1, ignore.case = TRUE),
                           "Preregistration and/or manuscript were too vague to tell or not reported",
                           deviation_c1),
    final_deviation_decision = if_else(deviation_agree %in% 1,
                                       deviation_c1,
                                       final_deviation_decision)
  )

write.csv(human_paired_resolved, "../Data/Processed/human_paired_resolved.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

# RegCheck inital data cleaning
```{r}
json_dir <- "../regcheck_data/regcheck/full/single_judge"

files <- list.files(json_dir, pattern = "^article_\\d+\\.json$", full.names = TRUE)

# sort numerically (otherwise article_10 comes before article_2)
files <- files[order(as.numeric(gsub("\\D", "", basename(files))))]
names(files) <- sub("\\.json$", "", basename(files))

read_one <- function(f) {
  x <- fromJSON(f)
  x <- map(x, ~ list(if (is.null(.x)) NA else .x))   # every field -> list-column
  as_tibble(x)
}

rc <- map(files, read_one) |>
  bind_rows(.id = "article") |>
  mutate(across(
    where(is.list),
    ~ if (all(map_lgl(.x, function(v) is.atomic(v) && length(v) == 1))) unlist(.x) else .x
  ))

# unnest the relevant columns
regcheckdata <- rc |>
  unnest(items, keep_empty = TRUE)

regcheckdata <- regcheckdata |>
  mutate(article = as.numeric(sub("^article_", "", article)))

regcheckdata_csv <- regcheckdata |>
  mutate(across(where(is.list), ~ map_chr(.x, \(v) paste(unlist(v), collapse = "; "))))

# Remove RegCheck chunk tags, e.g. "[PREREG_0004, relevance_score=0.397]" and the context it ads to quotes e.g., "[From Study 5....]"
regcheckdata_csv <- regcheckdata_csv |>
  mutate(across(c(registration_content_quotes, paper_content_quotes),
                ~ .x |>
                 str_remove_all("\\[[A-Z]+_\\d+,\\s*relevance_score=[0-9.]+\\]|\\[From [^\\]]*\\]") |>
                  str_squish()))

# Check: should return 0
sum(str_detect(regcheckdata_csv$registration_content_quotes,
               "relevance_score"), na.rm = TRUE)

write.csv(regcheckdata_csv, file = "../Data/Processed/regcheck_data.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```

## Clean full dataset 

### Synchronise responses and variable names
```{r }
# Relabel dimensions so that they're consistent across dataframes
human_paired_resolved <- human_paired_resolved |>
  mutate(dimension = recode(dimension,
    "datas"      = "Data source",
    "hypothesis" = "Hypotheses",
    "inex"       = "Inclusion and exclusion criteria",
    "manvars"    = "Manipulated variables",
    "measurvars" = "Measured variables",
    "missd"      = "Missing data",
    "samplesize" = "Sample size",
    "stats"      = "Statistical models",
    "transf"     = "Transformations"
  ))

full_cleaned_data <- left_join(human_paired_resolved, regcheckdata_cleaned, by = c("article_num", "dimension"))

# Synchronise all deviation judgment response options
clean_deviation <- function(x) {
  x <- str_trim(x)
  case_when(
      str_detect(x, regex("not pre-?registered", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ NA_character_, # to match individual codings where coders previously indicated that the dimension was not preregistered and then this variable was coded as NA
      str_detect(x, regex("too vague|^missing$", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~
      "Preregistration/ Manuscript were too vague to tell or information not reported.",
    str_detect(x, regex("^yes", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Yes",
    str_detect(x, regex("^no",  ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "No",
    TRUE ~ x
  )
}

full_cleaned_data <- full_cleaned_data |>
  mutate(across(c(deviation_c1, deviation_c2,
                  regcheck_deviation_judgment, final_deviation_decision),
                clean_deviation))

# Check: should show only the three labels (plus NA)
full_cleaned_data |>
  select(deviation_c1, deviation_c2, regcheck_deviation_judgment, final_deviation_decision) |>
  pivot_longer(everything()) |>
  count(value)
```

### Clean text variables
```{r }
# Clean the text
text_cols <- c("prereg_c1", "prereg_c2", "paper_c1", "paper_c2",
               "regcheck_registration_quotes", "regcheck_paper_quotes")

fix_ligatures <- function(x) {
  ligs <- c("fi", "fl", "ffi", "ff", "ffl")

  # Check every unique word once
  cores <- x[!is.na(x)] |> str_split(" ") |> unlist() |>
    str_remove("[[:punct:]]+$") |> unique()
  cores <- cores[str_detect(cores, "^[A-Za-z]+$")]
  ok <- setNames(hunspell_check(cores), cores)
  is_word <- function(w) unname(ok[w]) %in% TRUE

  try_ligs <- function(pre, post) {
    cands <- paste0(pre, ligs, post)
    hit <- hunspell_check(cands)
    if (any(hit)) cands[which(hit)[1]] else NA_character_
  }

  fix_one <- function(s) {
    toks <- str_split_1(s, " ")
    out <- character(length(toks))
    n <- 0
    i <- 1
    while (i <= length(toks)) {
      a <- toks[i]
      if (i < length(toks)) {
        b      <- toks[i + 1]
        b_core <- str_remove(b, "[[:punct:]]+$")
        b_end  <- coalesce(str_extract(b, "[[:punct:]]+$"), "")
        if (str_detect(a, "^[A-Za-z]{2,}$") && str_detect(b_core, "^[a-z]+$")) {
          both_words <- is_word(a) && is_word(b_core)
          if (!both_words || nchar(b_core) <= 3) {
            cand <- try_ligs(a, b_core)
            if (!is.na(cand) && (!both_words || nchar(cand) >= 6)) {
              n <- n + 1; out[n] <- paste0(cand, b_end); i <- i + 2; next
            }
          }
        }
      }
      a_core <- str_remove(a, "[[:punct:]]+$")
      a_end  <- coalesce(str_extract(a, "[[:punct:]]+$"), "")
      if (str_detect(a_core, "^[a-z]{2,}$") && !is_word(a_core)) {
        cand <- try_ligs("", a_core)
        if (!is.na(cand)) a <- paste0(cand, a_end)
      }
      n <- n + 1; out[n] <- a; i <- i + 1
    }
    paste(out[seq_len(n)], collapse = " ")
  }

  # Only process texts that contain at least one non-dictionary word
  bad_words <- names(ok)[!ok]
  needs <- !is.na(x) & map_lgl(str_split(x, " "), \(t) any(str_remove(t, "[[:punct:]]+$") %in% bad_words))

  x[needs] <- map_chr(x[needs], fix_one, .progress = TRUE)
  str_replace_all(x, "\\bProli c\\b", "Prolific")
}

clean_text <- function(x) {
  x <- x |>
    str_replace_all("\\\\[nrt]", " ") |>                     # literal "\n" typed as text
    replace_white() |>                                       # real newlines/tabs -> spaces
    replace_html(symbol = TRUE) |>                           # &amp; -> &, strips tags
    str_replace_all(c("¼" = "=", "þ" = "+", "À" = "-", "Â" = "×",
                      "ð" = "(", "Þ" = ")", "½" = "[")) |>   # PDF maths-font artefacts
    stringi::stri_trans_nfkc() |>                            # ligatures etc.
    replace_curly_quote() |>                                 # curly -> straight quotes
    str_replace_all("[\u2013\u2014\u2212]", "-") |>          # dashes
    str_remove_all("\\[\\s*(\\.\\.\\.|\u2026)\\s*\\]") |>    # [...] markers
    str_replace_all("(\\p{Ll})- (\\p{Ll})", "\\1\\2") |>     # PDF line-break hyphens
    str_remove_all("[\\p{Cc}\\p{Cf}\u00AD]") |>              # hidden characters, soft hyphens
    str_remove_all("\\[From [^\\]]*\\]") |>                  # RC study tags (also in human text)  <- NEW
    str_squish()                                             # extra spaces

  # "Not reported" entries -> NA
  not_reported <- "^(not reported\\.?|-+|na|n/a)$"
  if_else(str_detect(str_to_lower(x), not_reported), NA_character_, x)
}

full_cleaned_data <- full_cleaned_data |>
     mutate(across(any_of(text_cols), clean_text),
            across(c(paper_c1, paper_c2), fix_ligatures))

```

```{r}
# checks
long_text <- full_cleaned_data |>
  select(any_of(text_cols)) |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "column", values_to = "text") |>
  filter(!is_blank(text))

# 1. Hidden characters (should be 0)
sum(str_detect(long_text$text, "[\\p{Cc}\\p{Cf}\u00AD]"))

# 2. Broken ligatures (should be ~0)
broken <- "\\b(signi cant|speci c|con rm|de ned|identi ed|modi ed|nal|rst|in uence|ef cacy|Proli c)\\b"
long_text |> filter(str_detect(text, broken)) |> count(column)

# 3. PDF symbol artefacts (should be 0)
long_text |> filter(str_detect(text, "Ã|â€|Â|ð|Þ|¼")) |> count(column)

# 4. Leftover markers/tags (should be 0)
sum(str_detect(long_text$text, "\\[\\s*(\\.\\.\\.|\u2026)\\s*\\]|relevance_score=|\\[From "))

# 5. "Not reported" entries gone (should be empty)
long_text |> filter(str_detect(str_to_lower(text), "^(not reported\\.?|-+|na|n/a)$"))

# 6. Real line breaks in text columns (should be 0)
sum(str_detect(long_text$text, "\n"))


# Length check
long_text |>
  mutate(
    rater  = if_else(str_detect(column, "regcheck"), "RC", "Human"),
    source = if_else(str_detect(column, "paper"), "paper", "prereg"),
    n_words = str_count(text, "\\S+")
  ) |>
  group_by(source, rater) |>
  summarise(n = n(), min = min(n_words), median = median(n_words),
            max = max(n_words), .groups = "drop")
```

# Check all articles that should be in the dataset are in the dataset
```{r}
# Checks
article_list_data <- sort(unique(full_cleaned_data$article_num))

exclusions <- read_csv("../Data/Raw/exclusions.csv")

article_list_excl <- exclusions |> 
  filter(exclude == "Excluded") |> # For two articles, only earlier responses needed to be excluded
  pull(article_num) |> 
  unique() |> 
  sort()

# Any articles on the exclusion list that are still included in the full data?
intersect(article_list_data, article_list_excl)

# Any articles missing from the full list?
article_list_all <- sort(c(article_list_data, article_list_excl))

setdiff(seq(min(article_list_all), max(article_list_all)), article_list_all)

#final N should be 100
length(unique(article_list_data))
```
